pages.title: Accretion Disk Fragment
pages.text: Slag from the inner edge of an accretion disk, frozen where it was flung out. It still remembers ten million kelvin.

Made in $(item)Tectonic Press$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Accretion Slag Ore$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Tidal Stretcher.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Accretion Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Accretion Casing, Accretion Disk Plasma, Disk Confinement Ring, Quasar Jet Filament, Thermal Shroud.
